cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: I Know How to Win This
cards.instruction: Perform mastery of the rules, odds, and consequences while improvising every decision.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I've calculated the optimal move in this raffle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You buy a ticket. That's all.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. The timing of purchase is crucial.
